title: Sieve evaluation has no timeout; slow scripts block SMTP DATA handling
description: smtp/session.rs:557-598: Sieve script evaluation runs inline in the SMTP session task with no timeout. A script with expensive regex or large loops blocks the session thread indefinitely. Under 10 concurrent connections each triggering complex Sieve evaluation, the thread pool saturates. Fix: enforce a configurable Sieve eval timeout (e.g., 1-5 seconds); log exceedance at warn level; count eval timeouts in metrics.
